# land-query
> Area-queryable parcel facts for New Zealand, starting with Kāpiti Coast. Built from public data (LINZ, Kāpiti Coast District Council, Greater Wellington Regional Council). Every value carries its source, fetch time, licence and a fit-for-parcel flag.

- Repository: https://github.com/aashtonnz/land-query
- Pipeline (fetch, compile and query one 1 km tile): ./pipeline/
- Sources, licences and column definitions: ./SOURCES.md
- Example results with provenance: ./docs/findings/2026-11-06-inverse-queries.json

Status: the whole Kāpiti Coast district is compiled (27,614 parcels). No query service is running yet. The prototype in ./archive/ uses fictional data and is not a source of facts.
